name: Beijing Beimo High-tech Frictional Material Co.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Beimo High-tech Frictional Material Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of brake products for military aircraft and ground equipment. The company offers aircraft brake control systems, aircraft wheels, brake discs, landing gears, civil aviation aircraft landing gear, take-off and landing systems, and high-speed train brake products, as well as provision of electronic component screening and destructive physical analysis services and test programs. Its products are used by military, civilian dual-use aerospace vehicles, tanks, armored vehicles, fighter jets, bombers, and transport aircraft.
